content.title: Air Traffic Controller Salary for 2023-2024
content.text: Salary for Air Traffic Controllers Also known as: Air Traffic Control Operator, Air Traffic Control Specialist, Air Traffic Controller, Air Traffic Coordinator, Airport Tower Controller, Control Tower Operator, Enroute Controller Recruiter.com helps find better paying jobs across all specialties and locations. Sign up in our career community today! SEE MORE SALARIES FOR TRANSPORTATION PROFESSIONALS Air traffic controllers control air traffic within the vicinity of an airport. This job is not usually dangerous, but it does require that workers stand for long periods of time. These positions usually require vocational training, an associate's degree or related work in order for an applicant to be considered. Once hired, an air traffic controller will need up to two years of formal training before beginning work.A Air Traffic Controller will normally get salaries ranging from $72,760 and $184,780 depending on experience and talent. can get an average wage of one hundred and twenty-seven thousand four hundred and fourty dollars per year. can expect the most salary in New Hampshire, where they can earn an average pay rate of just about $147,710. These people are compensated the highest in Public Administration, where they earn an average pay rate of $130,180. The national wage distribution is shown below.
